title: Jonas Brothers’ The Burning Up Tour All Over Again 2026: How to Buy Affordable Tickets Online
summary: Following a sold-out run at Madison Square Garden, the trio is taking its “Burnin’ Up” era on a 45-city tour across North America.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

If you spent the late 2000s singing “Burnin’ Up” into a hairbrush, the Jonas Brothers have some very good news for you. After selling out their headlining shows at Madison Square Garden, Nick, Joe and Kevin Jonas are taking their Burning Up Tour All Over Again on the road for a 45-city American trek .

The shows will recreate the group’s 2008 Burnin’ Up Tour, giving fans a chance to hear some of the songs that helped define the Jonas Brothers’ early career, including “Year 3000,” “S.O.S.,” “When You Look Me in the Eyes,” “Play My Music” and, naturally, “Burnin’ Up.”

Shop Jonas Brothers Tour tICKETS AT tICKETMASTER

“We can’t wait to bring THE BURNING UP TOUR ALL OVER AGAIN across North America,” the Jonas Brothers shared on Instagram Aug. 17. “It’s a celebration of the songs, the memories, and everything that made the burning up era so special, ALL OVER AGAIN.”

And considering everything that has happened for the Jonas Brothers in 2026, the timing couldn’t be more fitting. Kevin, Joe and Nick recently returned to Disney Channel for Camp Rock 3 , were named Disney Legends during D23 and were announced as halftime performers for the NFL’s first-ever regular-season game in Australia.

Now, they’re going back to where it all began — at least, musically.

How to Get Jonas Brothers Tour Tickets Online

The general public can purchase tickets for the newly announced dates beginning Friday, Aug. 21, at 10 a.m. local time through Ticketmaster . Eligible Spotify Premium Top Fans can access the Reserved by Spotify presale, with additional presales taking place throughout the week.

Already know you want to see the JoBros live? Tickets are also available through trusted third-party sites, including StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork and Gametime . Prices may vary by date and seller and can be above or below face value.

EDITOR'S PICK

Find Jonas Brothers Tickets at StubHub

Buy tickets here

A top choice for finding Jonas Brothers tickets in 2026.

StubHub makes it easy to shop Jonas Brothers tickets with all-in pricing, meaning the fees are shown upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures your tickets are valid and arrive in time for the show. If there’s an issue, you’ll get your money back, while canceled shows that aren’t rescheduled qualify for either a full refund or 120% credit. At the time of publishing, tickets start at $167.

EARN REWARDS

Find Jonas Brothers Tickets at Vivid Seats

If you already have a specific view in mind, Vivid Seats makes it easy to filter Jonas Brothers tickets by seat type, from VIP and suites to front-of-section and standing-room options. The retailer’s 100% Buyer Guarantee covers your purchase, so you’ll receive legitimate tickets in time for the show or get your money back. You can save 10% on your first purchase by signing up for emails and use promo code BB30 for an additional $30 off. Tickets start at $92 at the time of publication.

PROMO CODES

Find Jonas Brothers Tickets at SeatGeek

Skip the paper ticket and get your Jonas Brothers tickets delivered straight to your phone. SeatGeek offers digital ticket delivery and lets you compare seats and prices before checking out. At the time of publishing, tickets start at $113.

PROMO CODE

Find Jonas Brothers Tickets at TicketNetwork

For more than just a seat at the show, check out TicketNetwork . The resale site offers Jonas Brothers ticket packages with perks such as VIP access, parking passes and meet-and-greets, along with all-in pricing that includes fees. Tickets start at $165, and Billboard readers can use BILLBOARD150 for $150 off orders over $500 or BILLBOARD300 for $300 off purchases of $1,000 or more.

SEATING OPTIONS

Find Jonas Brothers Tickets at Gametime

If you’re still searching for Jonas Brothers tickets, Gametime has a selection of tickets available online. The third-party marketplace guarantees low prices, on-time delivery and protection if your event is canceled. Tickets start at $131 as of this writing.
